{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence in upward moves.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5 days) when price is trending downward — model tends to overreact.",
    "When true price spikes sharply (e.g., >10% from prior day), reduce forecast overshoot by 10–15% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if 3 consecutive days show high forecast error (>5% deviation), adjust next forecast toward historical mean of last 7 days.",
    "For sentiment > 0.25, increase forecast sensitivity to recent price momentum — model underreacts to bullish sentiment.",
    "In late-period forecasts (last 10 days), reduce forecast magnitude by 5–10% to account for lagged market reaction and reduced volatility.",
    "If true price exceeds forecast by >15% for 2+ consecutive days, apply downward correction to prevent runaway overestimation."
  ]
}
